overview: Alappuzha (Alleppey) is the gateway to Kerala's backwaters. The classic experience is an overnight private houseboat gliding past paddy fields, villages and coconut palms, with meals cooked on board.
fit: Relaxed and fun for both kids, but the boat has open edges, so constant supervision for the 4-year-old.
season: November to February is pleasant (23–32°C). March–May is hot and humid. June–September is the monsoon; the Nehru Trophy snake boat race is in August.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Kochi, then 1.5 hr drive

gettingAround: Short cabs and autos in town; the houseboat does the rest.

todo.title: Overnight private houseboat
todo.why: Your own boat, crew and cook for 22 hours
todo.book: Book a licensed operator with life jackets and good reviews; avoid peak Christmas week or book early

todo.title: Shikara (small canopy boat) ride
todo.why: Narrow canals the houseboats can't enter

food.name: Karimeen pollichathu
food.note: Pearl spot fish in banana leaf (non-veg)

foodTips: Ask the houseboat cook for mild vegetarian food when you book.
save: Book directly with a houseboat operator, not via middlemen at the jetty
A day cruise is cheaper if you skip the night
safety: Life jackets for the kids at all times on deck
Choose a boat with railings and an enclosed upper deck
Use mosquito repellent in the evening
kids: Bring games and books for slow hours on the boat
The 4-year-old will love the ducks and fishing boats

days.plan: Fly to Kochi, drive to Marari beach resort
Board the houseboat at noon; cruise and overnight on the water
Drive to Kochi and fly home
